348.title: Alien
348.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal sent by a nearby planet. The crew discovers a nest of eggs and one of them hatches into a deadly organism.

679.title: Aliens
679.overview: When Ripley's lifepod is found by a salvage crew over 50 years later, she finds that terra-formers are on the very planet they found the alien species. When the company sends a family of colonists out to investigate her story, all contact is lost.

8077.title: Alien³
8077.overview: Ripley is the sole survivor after her escape pod crashes on Fiorina 161, a prison planet, where she discovers that the alien threat has followed her.

8078.title: Alien: Resurrection
8078.overview: Two hundred years after Ripley's death, military scientists clone her to study the alien queen inside her - a decision they come to regret.

70981.title: Prometheus
70981.overview: Following clues to the origin of mankind, a team finds a structure on a distant moon, but they soon realise they are not alone.

126889.title: Alien: Covenant
126889.overview: The crew of the colony ship Covenant discover what they think is an uncharted paradise, but it is a dark, dangerous world.

157336.title: Interstellar
157336.overview: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

27205.title: Inception
27205.overview: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO.

603.title: The Matrix
603.overview: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality and his role in the war against its controllers.
